title: Biology scholarships
text:
The following list of biology scholarships is primarily for American biology students. This list can be reorganized to incorporate scholarship programs in other countries. Just make that reorganization as clear and as clean as possible.

Additions to this list are welcomed and encouraged. Please don't be stingy about letting students in on how they can finance their educations! If you are unfamiliar with how to edit a Wiki and don't have time to learn, please contact Mathew Crawford using the email crawford@artofproblemsolving.com with the scholarship listing you wish to contribute.


National Biology Scholarships[edit]

  • NIH Undergraduate Scholarship Program for disadvantaged students committed to careers in biomedical, behavioral, and social science health-related research. Program offers scholarship support, paid research training in the summer, and paid employment and training at NIH after graduation. website
  • CampusRXBio Scholarship Fund website
  • Young Epidemiology Scholars (YES) Competition. Students can win up to \$>50,000 for outstanding research projects using epidemiological methods. website
